title: Outfit Rotation and Favourites
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=outfit:wear
| stats count as wears, latest(_time) as last by item
| eventstats avg(wears) as avg_wears
| eval overworn=if(wears>avg_wears*2,1,0)
| sort - wears
description: Shows which items you wear far more than the rest, revealing your true favourites and rotation ruts.
value: Knowing you cycle through the same few pieces helps you either embrace a capsule wardrobe or shop your own closet.
implementation: Ingest wears into `index=personal`; rank items by wear count.
visualization: Bar chart of wear count by item.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which clothes you wear far more than others, revealing your real favourites.
